omar_oncall: Agreed. Minimal artifacts: rolebinding patch, CI build log with SHA, k8s-audit excerpt, CloudTrail export, and KMS describe + rotation status.
auditor_claire: Staging replay OK. Please redact customer IDs and replace real hostnames. A CSV mapping artifact->control ID is helpful.
vikas_platform: I'll provision a throwaway service account and apply a rolebinding in staging during the window. Will capture kubectl apply output and the controller logs.
nisha_sec: Paste the exact commands/queries you'll include so the auditor can reproduce.
vikas_platform: kubectl apply command (example):
```bash
kubectl -n staging apply -f rolebinding-staging-demo.yaml --record
kubectl get events --field-selector involvedObject.name=demo-binding -n staging -o yaml | head -n 40
```
Splunk/CloudTrail example query I'll export:
```splunk
index=cloudtrail eventName=PutRole* OR eventName=AttachRolePolicy | table _time, userIdentity.principalId, eventName, requestParameters
```
tools-bot: Artifact uploaded: ci-run-4921.log (redacted).

aws kms describe-key --key-id <redacted>
